mapper.select: select f.id, f.fault_no, f.inspection_task_id, t.task_no as inspection_task_no, f.inspection_record_id, f.equipment_id, e.code as equipment_code, e.name as equipment_name, a.name as area_name, f.reporter_id, u.display_name as reporter_name, f.fault_type, f.fault_level, f.description, f.status, f.reported_at, f.resolved_at, f.closed_at, w.id as work_order_id, w.work_order_no from fault_record f join inspection_task t on t.id = f.inspection_task_id join equipment e on e.id = f.equipment_id join area a on a.id = e.area_id join sys_user u on u.id = f.reporter_id left join work_order w on w.fault_record_id = f.id where f.id = #{faultRecordId}
mapper.insert: insert into fault_record (fault_no, inspection_task_id, inspection_record_id, equipment_id, reporter_id, fault_type, fault_level, description, status, reported_at) values (#{faultNo}, #{inspectionTaskId}, #{inspectionRecordId}, #{equipmentId}, #{reporterId}, #{faultType}, #{faultLevel}, #{description}, #{status}, #{reportedAt})
mapper.update: update fault_record set status = 'PROCESSING', version = version + 1 where id = #{faultRecordId} and status in ('ORDER_CREATED', 'PROCESSING')

update fault_record set status = 'CLOSED', resolved_at = #{closedAt}, closed_at = #{closedAt}, version = version + 1 where id = #{faultRecordId} and status in ('ORDER_CREATED', 'PROCESSING', 'RESOLVED')
